topography.project_purpose: Katana Pre-Launch is a DeFi protocol that provides yield-bearing vaults and cross-chain token bridging. It enables users to deposit assets into Yearn V3 and BoringVaults for automated yield generation, and to move tokens across chains via LayerZero and a canonical Agglayer bridge.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Katana Pre-Launch vaults mint yield-bearing tokens that can be bridged via the Vault Bridge or LayerZero adapters, while the Agglayer bridge provides a canonical path to the Katana chain. Shared infrastructure like GnosisSafe and Permit2 supports governance and token approvals across families.
